subject: Stakeholder map & MAP: next steps for FinPay evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anil Gupta <anil.gupta@finpay.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@finpay.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder map & MAP: next steps for FinPay evaluation

Hi Anil / Priya —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and we can lock on next steps: 

- Primary use case: real-time fraud scoring and chargeback reduction on high-value merchant flows.
- Key success criteria: latency <= 120ms p50 for 1-2k TPS, deterministic cost per 1M tokens, evidence of SOC2 + data isolation for PCI-related PII.
- Current stakeholders:
  - Technical lead: Anil Gupta (you) — performance & integration
  - Economic buyer: Priya Menon — procurement and budget
  - Security/Legal: procurement@finpay.com (security questionnaire + SOC2)

Proposed MAP (attached): outline milestones, owner, target dates. High-level milestones I recommend:
1) Security review & SOC2 evidence — FinPay security to review (target 2 weeks)
2) Technical POC (3-5 day test window) — Redwood provides test harness and dedicated tenant
3) Procurement & contracting — agreeable terms + SOW, target 3 weeks
4) Pilot launch and evaluation — 4 weeks, measure latency/cost/quality

Next steps we agreed on call:
- I’ll share a first draft of the MAP and a stakeholder map by EOD. (Marissa)
- Anil to confirm technical integration requirements and any PCI-specific constraints.
- Priya to loop in procurement and send the security questionnaire contact.

Attached: FinPay_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), stakeholder spreadsheet (coming).

If that matches your read, we can lock the dates and I’ll create the HubSpot deal tasks.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: FinPay_MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 214 KB)

From: Anil Gupta <anil.gupta@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finpay.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder map & MAP: next steps for FinPay evaluation

Thanks Marissa — this matches our discussion. A few clarifications from my side: 

- For POC, we need a Redis-compatible KV cache for live transaction lookups; can Redwood provide a hosted endpoint or should we run a sidecar?
- PCI note: we cannot have raw PANs sent to external inference endpoints. We’ll need tokenization at ingest or an on-prem option for the pilot.
- Can you share your SOC2 cert summary and any network isolation options?

I’ll pull together a one-pager on our infra constraints and share with your team by EOD tomorrow.

-Anil
Head of Platform Engineering, FinPay
---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anil Gupta <anil.gupta@finpay.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@finpay.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder map & MAP: next steps for FinPay evaluation

Anil — thanks, noted. I’ve attached a slightly updated MAP and the stakeholder spreadsheet (separate file) with the roles we discussed. High-level answers inline: 

- Redis-compatible cache: Redwood can support a hosted prefix cache for the POC; for PCI-sensitive flows an on-prem or VPC private deployment is recommended — we’ll include both options in the MAP with estimated cost deltas.
- Tokenization: agreed — do not send PANs. We recommend tokenization at ingest or passing a token ID; will work with your infra team to validate.
- Attached SOC2 summary and network isolation options. If the procurement/security team wants docs, we can open an NDA & dedicated S3 share for evidence.

Attached: FinPay_stakeholder_map.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

Proposed immediate dates (adjustable):
- Security review kickoff: Sep 6 (target docs due Sep 13)
- POC start: Sep 15 (3 business days)
- Commercial draft shared: Sep 20

Can Priya confirm procurement cadence?

Best,
Marissa
---
Attachments: FinPay_stakeholder_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 28 KB); SOC2-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 98 KB)

- Marissa: I’ll own the security pack handoff and will prepare a short evidence bundle (SOC2 scope, network diagrams, data retention policy) if we get an NDA.
- Jonas: can you add the MAP milestones to HubSpot and create the task reminders for follow-ups (security kickoff Sep 6)?

Keep external thread quiet until we have Priya/procurement dates confirmed.

Marissa — thanks for the materials. Procurement confirmed they need the SOC2 summary and network diagram; I’ve CC'd procurement@finpay.com here.

Procurement cadence: they have a standard 3-week review for pilots + a separate pricing committee that will review any committed capacity discounts. I’ve asked procurement to provide the security questionnaire contact info by Monday Sep 6.

On the econ side: we have headroom in Q4 but need a commercial draft by Sep 20 to make budget for the Nov pilot. Please send the SOW/draft commercial and I’ll route through our pricing committee.
